requirements: Teachers can mark student attendance via a QR-code scan at the start of each class
Parents receive an SMS alert when a student is marked absent for more than two consecutive days
Students can view their attendance history and track their progress through a web portal
Admins can generate attendance reports for individual students, classes, or the entire school
Teachers can add notes to a student's attendance record to explain excused absences
Parents can submit attendance excuses for their children through an online form
The system automatically flags students with low attendance rates for review by school administrators
Teachers can use a mobile app to take attendance during field trips or off-site events
Attendance data must sync within 5 seconds so teachers see live counts during class
The system must be able to handle 500 concurrent users during peak hours when teachers take attendance
The attendance database must be backed up daily to prevent data loss in case of a system failure
The system must comply with FERPA regulations to protect student attendance data
The mobile app for taking attendance must be compatible with both iOS and Android devices

risk_report.stage: Gather Requirements
risk_report.risk: Inadequate requirements gathering may lead to misunderstandings of stakeholder needs.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and workshops to validate requirements.

risk_report.stage: Design Database Schema
risk_report.risk: Inefficient database schema design may result in poor data retrieval performance.
risk_report.mitigation: Utilize entity-relationship modeling and indexing to optimize database schema design.

risk_report.stage: Design User Interface
risk_report.risk: Poor user interface design may lead to user frustration and low adoption rates.
risk_report.mitigation: Apply user-centered design principles and conduct usability testing to validate interface design.

risk_report.stage: Design Mobile App
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent mobile app design may compromise user experience across different devices.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a responsive design that adapts to various mobile devices and screen sizes.

risk_report.stage: Develop QR-Code Scanner
risk_report.risk: QR-code scanner malfunction may cause attendance tracking errors.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement robust error handling and testing to ensure reliable QR-code scanning functionality.

risk_report.stage: Develop Attendance Tracking
risk_report.risk: Inaccurate attendance tracking may lead to incorrect attendance records.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement data validation and verification processes to ensure accurate attendance tracking.

risk_report.stage: Develop SMS Alert System
risk_report.risk: Unreliable SMS alert system may fail to notify stakeholders of important events.
risk_report.mitigation: Utilize a reputable SMS gateway service and implement retry mechanisms to ensure reliable message delivery.

risk_report.stage: Develop Web Portal
risk_report.risk: Insecure web portal may expose sensitive user data to unauthorized access.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement robust security measures, including encryption and secure authentication protocols.

risk_report.stage: Develop Admin Reports
risk_report.risk: Inaccurate or incomplete admin reports may compromise decision-making.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop reports with clear and concise data visualizations and implement data validation to ensure accuracy.

risk_report.stage: Develop Mobile App
risk_report.risk: Mobile app security vulnerabilities may put user data at risk.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement secure coding practices, conduct regular security audits, and utilize secure data storage.

risk_report.stage: Develop Online Excuse Form
risk_report.risk: Insecure online excuse form may allow unauthorized users to submit false excuses.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms to ensure only authorized users can submit excuses.

risk_report.stage: Develop Low Attendance Flagging
risk_report.risk: Inaccurate low attendance flagging may incorrectly identify students as having low attendance.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement data validation and verification processes to ensure accurate attendance tracking and flagging.

risk_report.stage: Implement Data Syncing
risk_report.risk: Data syncing errors may cause inconsistencies across different systems.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement robust data syncing mechanisms with error handling and logging to ensure data consistency.

risk_report.stage: Implement Load Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate load testing may fail to identify performance bottlenecks.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough load testing with realistic user scenarios to identify and address performance issues.

risk_report.stage: Implement FERPA Compliance
risk_report.risk: Non-compliance with FERPA regulations may result in legal and reputational consequences.
risk_report.mitigation: Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure all systems and processes adhere to FERPA regulations.

risk_report.stage: Unit Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate unit testing may allow defects to go undetected.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop comprehensive unit tests with high code coverage to ensure individual components function correctly.

risk_report.stage: Integration Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate integration testing may fail to identify interoperability issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough integration testing to ensure seamless interactions between components and systems.

risk_report.stage: System Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate system testing may allow critical defects to go undetected.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop comprehensive system tests that simulate real-world scenarios to ensure the system functions as expected.

risk_report.stage: User Acceptance Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate user acceptance testing may fail to validate system functionality from a user perspective.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve end-users in the testing process to ensure the system meets their needs and expectations.

risk_report.stage: Deploy to Production
risk_report.risk: Deployment errors may cause system downtime or data loss.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a thorough deployment plan with rollback procedures and conduct deployment testing in a staging environment.

risk_report.stage: Configure Daily Backups
risk_report.risk: Inadequate backup configuration may result in data loss in the event of a disaster.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement automated daily backups with redundancy and store backups in a secure, offsite location.

risk_report.stage: Monitor System Performance
risk_report.risk: Inadequate performance monitoring may fail to identify issues before they impact users.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement real-time performance monitoring with alerts and notifications to quickly identify and address performance issues.

requirements: Teachers can mark student attendance via biometric fingerprint scan within 3 seconds of class start time to ensure real-time accuracy.
The system automatically generates a daily attendance report for each class and sends it to the principal's dashboard before 10:00 AM the next day.
Parents receive an instant push notification on their mobile app when their child is marked absent, including the reason (if provided by the teacher).
Students can view their own attendance history for the current semester through the student portal, filtered by course and date range.
The system enforces a 15-minute grace period for late arrivals; students marked late are flagged in red on the teacher's attendance sheet.
Admins can configure attendance thresholds (e.g., 85% minimum) per course, triggering automated email alerts to students who fall below the threshold.
Teachers can override attendance records for students with valid medical excuses, attaching supporting documents directly in the system.
The system integrates with the school's timetable to pre-populate attendance sheets for each class, reducing manual entry errors by 90%.
The system must support offline mode for teachers in areas with poor connectivity, syncing attendance data to the server within 10 seconds of reconnection.
Attendance data must be backed up to a secondary server every 5 minutes to prevent data loss during unexpected outages.
The mobile app for parents must load attendance notifications within 2 seconds on devices with 2GB RAM or higher.
The system must comply with FERPA regulations, ensuring student attendance data is encrypted at rest and in transit with AES-256 encryption.
The attendance dashboard for principals must render with a maximum latency of 3 seconds, even when querying data for 10,000+ students across 200+ classes.

risk_report.stage: Gather detailed requirements and create SRS document
risk_report.risk: Incomplete or ambiguous requirements leading to scope creep or rework.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct structured requirement workshops with stakeholders and validate with prototypes.

risk_report.stage: Define system architecture and high-level design
risk_report.risk: Poor scalability or performance bottlenecks due to flawed architectural decisions.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage experienced architects and conduct peer reviews against performance benchmarks.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema for attendance, users, and timetables
risk_report.risk: Inefficient schema causing slow query performance during peak loads.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize schema for data integrity but denormalize for read-heavy operations and index strategically.

risk_report.stage: Design API endpoints for attendance, reports, and notifications
risk_report.risk: API design flaws leading to excessive data transfer or security vulnerabilities.
risk_report.mitigation: Follow RESTful principles, implement pagination, and enforce strict input validation.

risk_report.stage: Design UI/UX for teacher, student, parent, and admin portals
risk_report.risk: Poor usability causing user adoption issues or increased support burden.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct iterative usability testing with target users and follow accessibility guidelines.

risk_report.stage: Set up development environment and CI/CD pipeline
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent environments causing deployment failures or integration issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use infrastructure-as-code and containerization to ensure reproducibility.

risk_report.stage: Implement biometric fingerprint integration with 3-second latency
risk_report.risk: Biometric hardware incompatibility or slow response times degrading user experience.
risk_report.mitigation: Test with multiple biometric devices early and optimize SDK performance.

risk_report.stage: Implement real-time attendance recording and validation
risk_report.risk: Data inconsistency or race conditions during concurrent attendance submissions.
risk_report.mitigation: Use distributed locks or transactional outbox patterns to ensure consistency.

risk_report.stage: Implement daily attendance report generation and scheduling
risk_report.risk: Report generation delays or failures during high-volume periods.
risk_report.mitigation: Schedule reports during off-peak hours and implement async processing with retries.

risk_report.stage: Implement instant push notification system for parents
risk_report.risk: Notification delivery failures or delays due to third-party service limitations.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement fallback channels (SMS/email) and monitor delivery metrics closely.

risk_report.stage: Implement student attendance history portal with filtering
risk_report.risk: Slow query performance when filtering large historical datasets.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement database indexing, caching, and client-side pagination.

risk_report.stage: Implement grace period logic and late flagging in teacher UI
risk_report.risk: Incorrect grace period calculations leading to unfair attendance marking.
risk_report.mitigation: Validate logic with school policies and conduct unit tests for edge cases.

risk_report.stage: Implement admin configurable attendance thresholds and alerts
risk_report.risk: Misconfigured thresholds causing false positives or missed critical alerts.
risk_report.mitigation: Provide clear documentation and validation rules for admin settings.

risk_report.stage: Implement teacher override and document attachment feature
risk_report.risk: Unauthorized overrides or document tampering compromising data integrity.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement audit logs, role-based access control, and document versioning.

risk_report.stage: Integrate with school timetable system and pre-populate attendance sheets
risk_report.risk: Timetable sync failures leading to incorrect attendance pre-population.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement sync validation checks and fallback to manual entry if sync fails.

risk_report.stage: Implement offline mode with 10-second sync on reconnection
risk_report.risk: Data loss or corruption during offline operations or sync conflicts.
risk_report.mitigation: Use conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs) and implement robust sync protocols.

risk_report.stage: Set up secondary server backup every 5 minutes
risk_report.risk: Backup failures or corruption leading to data loss during catastrophic events.
risk_report.mitigation: Automate backup verification and implement geographically distributed backups.

risk_report.stage: Optimize mobile app for 2-second load time on 2GB RAM devices
risk_report.risk: Poor app performance on low-end devices causing user abandonment.
risk_report.mitigation: Profile app performance early and optimize memory usage and network calls.

risk_report.stage: Implement AES-256 encryption for data at rest and in transit
risk_report.risk: Implementation flaws or key management issues compromising data security.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established libraries/frameworks and conduct third-party security audits.

risk_report.stage: Optimize principal dashboard for 3-second max latency with large datasets
risk_report.risk: Dashboard queries timing out or freezing during peak usage.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement server-side pagination, caching, and query optimization techniques.

risk_report.stage: Unit test all modules and integration points
risk_report.risk: Incomplete test coverage leading to undetected bugs in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce code coverage thresholds and conduct peer reviews of test cases.

risk_report.stage: Perform system integration testing with biometric devices and timetable sync
risk_report.risk: Integration failures due to hardware or API changes in third-party systems.
risk_report.mitigation: Test with production-like hardware and maintain version compatibility matrices.

risk_report.stage: Conduct performance and load testing (10,000+ students, 200+ classes)
risk_report.risk: Undetected performance bottlenecks causing system failure under real-world loads.
risk_report.mitigation: Simulate realistic load patterns and monitor key metrics under stress.

risk_report.stage: Perform security testing and FERPA compliance audit
risk_report.risk: Security vulnerabilities or compliance gaps leading to legal penalties or data breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage third-party security experts and conduct regular penetration testing.

risk_report.stage: Conduct user acceptance testing (UAT) with teachers, parents, admins
risk_report.risk: Misaligned expectations or usability issues causing rejection of the system.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve end-users early in the design process and gather feedback iteratively.

risk_report.stage: Deploy to staging environment and finalize documentation
risk_report.risk: Staging environment inconsistencies leading to deployment surprises in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Ensure staging mirrors production exactly and validate all configurations.

risk_report.stage: Deploy to production with phased rollout plan
risk_report.risk: Unforeseen issues in production causing widespread disruptions.
risk_report.mitigation: Use feature flags, canary releases, and rollback procedures.

risk_report.stage: Monitor post-deployment performance and user feedback
risk_report.risk: Undetected issues escalating due to lack of proactive monitoring.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement comprehensive logging, alerting, and user feedback channels.

risk_report.stage: Provide training and support for end-users
risk_report.risk: Inadequate training leading to low adoption or misuse of the system.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop role-specific training materials and provide ongoing support channels.
